summary:
Implemented a shared offline-route slice.

Added Copy Route Plan to:
- Global Search Offline Launch Pad
- Quick Sheet Print / Offline Pack

After Check Routes or Prime Routes, it copies a plain-text plan showing which key routes are cached and which should be opened while still online. Updated search coverage, smoke assertions, service-worker cache to `ridgeline-console-v387`, `AGENT_STATE.md`, `SITE_QUALITY_AUDIT.md`, and public Anton status.

Verification passed:
- `Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('quick-sheet.html')`
- `Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('index.html')`
- `Test-InternalLinks.ps1`
- `Invoke-SiteAudit.ps1 -Pages @('quick-sheet.html','index.html') -Tag audit-v387-offline-route-plan -SkipScreenshots`

Next slice: real-iPhone review of Copy Route Plan before leaving signal, then rotate to Diagnostics handoff cleanup or iPhone header/Dynamic Island review.

Impact Reason: It makes the iPhone site more useful before weak-signal roadside use by turning cache readiness into a shareable checklist.
